# Tyler Chonoles’ Post

Securing AI | Growth Marketing @ Harmonic Security

2mo

Edited

Excited to share that I’ve officially joined Harmonic Security as their new Growth and Demand Gen Marketing Manager! The problem Harmonic is solving is one I genuinely believe matters: enabling the safe use of AI. As AI becomes embedded in how every team works, organizations are facing a real question: how do you let your people benefit from these tools without putting sensitive data at risk? Harmonic’s answer is elegant. Rather than simply blocking AI tools, Harmonic gives security teams full visibility into how AI is being used across their organization, detects sensitive data in real time using their own small language models, and coaches employees toward secure behavior at the exact moment it matters. I couldn’t be more proud to join this team. Getting to know Ana Corio and Michael Marriott throughout the process, and being able to work alongside my good friend Jackson Harrower, made this decision incredibly easy. NEW YORK, Oct. 10, 2018 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- DMN, a leading provider of digital and data-driven marketing news, is excited to celebrate 40 of the best, most accomplished, high-level superheroes in the business of marketing today – all under the age of 40.

DMN's 40Under40 recognizes these extraordinary young marketers from across brands, agencies, and vendors, who are not only succeeding, but excelling in their careers. Their outstanding achievements through creativity, innovation, support, leadership, and company advancement in marketing, is what makes DMN proud to honor them.

On November 6, 2018 marketing heroes will unite at Dream Downtown in NYC, for a night of libations, great food, even better conversations, and a festive awards ceremony.
